notes.title: Update 1.1.1
notes.content:
[b]BALANCE[/b]
- Moderately reduced the difficulty of [i]Normal[/i]
- Slightly reduced the difficulty of [i]Heroic[/i]

notes.title: Update 1.1
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44751615/41dd792e4b664bfd87794352491f554951e39a8e.jpg[/img]
[b]NEXUS[/b]
- Increase starting Fragments by 10. This change allows two towers to be built before the first wave with a lower Nexus level, making the beginning of levels more varied.

[b]ESSENCES[/b]
- [b]New Essence - Void Ray:[/b] The first Legendary Neutral Essence. Deals 13 Damage over 3 seconds to an Enemy for every 10 Generated Mana. 0 Mana Cost. 35 Range. 13 second cooldown.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44751615/79c0ea858ee0f473b1a0267c3e4dffdd067dc6dd.jpg[/img]

- Fire Rune: Base damage increased from 7 -> 8
- Cold Snap: Cooldown reduced from 14 -> 13 seconds
- Arc Lightning: Base damage increased from 15 -> 17
- Lifebloom: Cooldown reduced from 14 -> 13 seconds
- Divine Wrath: Base damage increased from 26 -> 28
- Overload: Cooldown reduced from 13 -> 12 seconds
- Detonation: Base damage increased from 23 -> 26
- Aegis: Cooldown reduced from 16 -> 15 seconds
- Sunder: Base damage increased from 19 -> 21

[b]SHARDS[/b]
- Aftershock: Reduced the amount of charges required to cast from 6 -> 5
- Lifebinder: Cooldown reduced from 6 -> 5 seconds
- Permafrost: Cooldown reduced from 12 -> 11 seconds

[b]ENVIRONMENT[/b]
- Various improvements to level environments and level environment effects

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44751615/a552f00b46aaedfe7aaa1d8a82bc2ad4cbb50679.jpg[/img]
[b]ENEMIES[/b]
- Colossus: Base health slightly reduced
- Lifeseed - Life Leech: Cooldown reduced from 15 -> 14 seconds
- Stormbringer - Static Discharge: Range increased from 30 -> 35
- Icebane: Base health slightly reduced
- Frozen Sentinel - Glacial Shield: Cooldown increased from 38 -> 40 seconds
- Magma Worm - Spit Fire: Increased cooldown from 9 -> 10 seconds

Vazrah'Mor, the Infernal:
- Eruption: Base damage reduced from 11 -> 9
- Lava Surge: Base damage reduced from 3 -> 2
- Pyroclast: Minimum base damage reduced from 2 -> 1

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44751615/f80a64ee9ba01dfffc455a6c6ea0bd58e1752fbb.jpg[/img]
[b]LEVELS[/b]
- Farevyr Strait: Difficulty slightly reduced
- Scar of Rhyn: Difficulty slightly reduced
- Bal'Molag: Reduced the amount of enemies that spawn during the boss wave

[b]BUGS[/b]
- Fixed Molten Core not triggering if the Incineration tower that casted it was demolished before the effect triggered

REPLAYS
- Replays now allow the use of all Towers, Essences, and Shards that have been unlocked so far, instead of being limited to only those that had been unlocked when the level was originally completed

ENEMIES
- Rak'Thor, the Earthshaper: Max Health reduced slightly
- Ast'Akar, the Tempest: Max Health increased slightly
- Wyhmneir, the Leviathan: Max Health increased slightly
- Vazrah'Mor, the Infernal: Damage of all abilities reduced by ~20%
- Magma Worm: Max Health reduced slightly, attack cooldown increased from 8 -> 9 seconds

ESSENCES
- Ice Barrier: Increased cooldown from 12 -> 13 seconds
- Arc Lightning: Increased damage from 15 -> 17
- Evoke: Reduced mana reduction time from 15 -> 12 seconds
- Divine Wrath: Increased damage from 24 -> 28
- Superheated: Reduced cooldown from 7 -> 6 seconds
- Molten Core: Increased damage from 5 -> 6
- Infernal Orb: Reduced cooldown from 11 -> 10 seconds
- Inferno: Increased duration from 5 -> 6 seconds 
- Detonation: Increased damage from 18 -> 23
- Resonance: Decreased Generated Mana duration from 10 -> 9 seconds
- Innervate: Cooldown reduced from 5 -> 4 seconds
- Torment: Increased bonus damage taken from 30 -> 35%
- Sunder: Reduced healing provided to nearby enemies from 50 -> 25% of damage dealt
- Chaotic Blast: Reduced damage dealt to towers from 2 -> 1

UI
- Added UI scale adjustment to the player settings to improve accessibility
- Added button to Level Over panel explaining how Soul is generated

LEVEL
- The paths and tower overview will now remain active between level attempts if they were active before restarting the level

BUGS
- Fixed camera sometimes being in the wrong position after a cinematic plays
- Fixed game volume setting not correctly applying on level restart

DISPLAY
- Improved support for ultrawide monitors (32:9), allowing them to fully zoom out in levels
- Improved the game menu's text legibility and button positioning on ultrawide monitors

PERFORMANCE
- Added max frame rate limiting if VSync is disabled

MISC
- Added 'Lock Cursor' option in the player settings, allowing the cursor to be optionally confined to the screen (was previously always enabled by default)

BALANCE
- Slightly increased difficulty of Normal
- Increased amount of enemies that spawn during bosses

UI
- Increased speed of scry, mine, and level completion animations

BUGS
- Fixed some sound effects being played too close together
- Fixed camera sometimes being off-center after the intro cinematic before the first level

LEVELS
- Redesigned "Shimmering Coast" and "Valley of the Colossus"
- Improved various Act II and Act III level environments

ENEMIES
- Increased the status resistance of bosses, making Immobilizes and Stuns less effective against them

ESSENCES
- Overload: Increased bonus Damage per Enemy from 3% -> 5%, max bonus Damage increased from 45% -> 75%

GRAPHICS
- Significantly improved the lighting of towers, Essences, enemies, Shards, Nexus, and environment features

LEVELS
- Improved environment design of Act I levels

SHARDS
- Increased range of Aftershock, Ascendant, Chronowarp, and Redemption Shards from 30 -> 35

LEVELS
- Levels in Act II and Act III reward up to 30% more Fragments, allowing more Towers to be built and Essences to be assigned. Wave difficulty has been increased to compensate
- Levels "Shattered Plateau" and "Valley of Giants" have been redesigned

ESSENCES
- Fire Rune: Damage reduced from 10 -> 8, Mana cost increased from 4 -> 5
- Blizzard: Max damage increased from 3 -> 4 damage per second
- Evoke: Mana reduction time increased from 12 -> 15 seconds
- Annihilate: Damage increased from 400% -> 500% of health sacrificed

RUNES
- Windstorm: Increased stack duration from 15 -> 20 seconds

SHARDS
- Shard costs adjusted from 50/125/250/425 to 40/110/230/460

ENEMIES
- Frozen Sentinel: Glacial Shield: Amount absorbed reduced by 25%. Cooldown increased from 34 -> 40 seconds

SHARDS
- Shards can now be destroyed if they have not been active in the wave, allowing them to be placed at a different position or for a different Shard to be placed instead

BALANCE
- Minor adjustments to level difficulties

notes.title: Act III
notes.content:
Brave the frigid peaks of Haedmyr to battle Wyhmneir, the Leviathan.

GAMEPLAY
- Towers gain less Max Health from leveling up the Nexus.

ESSENCES
- Aegis (Reworked): Place an Aegis on ANY Tower, causing it to gain 75% Damage Reduction until it takes Damage 3 times. 2 Mana. 15 sec cooldown.
- Inferno: Bonus damage reduced from 150% to 50%. Duration reduced from 6 to 5 seconds.
- Annihilate: Increased damaged dealt from 300% to 400% of Health sacrificed.

RUNES
- Dark Pact: Changed the damage dealt to the Tower from a percentage of Max Health to a fixed amount.

BUGS
- Fixed tooltip sometimes remaining shown when it should be hidden
- Fixed essence panel sometimes incorrectly showing that a tower is selected

ESSENCES
- Immolation: Always deals 3 Damage to the Tower instead of scaling with Max Health.

ENEMIES
- Rumbler: Crumble (Reworked): Split into 3 Shardlings, each with a third of this Enemy's current Health. 40 second cooldown.

LEVELS
- Minorly reduced the difficulty of all levels

Improved support for widescreen monitors

UI
- Improved overworld Vault, Nexus, and Archive UI on widescreen monitors
- Fixed incorrect tooltip placement on widescreen monitors

GAMEPLAY
- Enemies will now target the same towers with their abilities across level attempts instead of being random.

ENEMIES
- Rumbler: Crumble will now trigger when the enemy is reduced below 50% health instead of when defeated. Max Health has been doubled to compensate.

notes.title: Act II
notes.content:
Traverse the desert plains of Eranakis to defeat Ast'Akar atop the Shattered Plateau.

GAMEPLAY
- Increased speed of 'Faster' and 'Max' gamespeeds.
- Add new Altar after Fractured Isles level.

ESSENCES
- Chaotic Blast: Reduced damage dealt to Towers by 50%.
- Fire Orb: Cooldown increased from 8 to 11 seconds.
- Lifebloom: Will now Heal the target Tower for 9 health in addition to increasing its Max Health.
- Ice Barrier: Reduced damage absorbed reduced from 9 to 7. Damage dealt reduced from 11 to 8. Cooldown reduced from 13 to 12.
- Inferno: Reduced bonus damage from 200% to 150%.
- Duality: Damage increased from 100% to 125% of all recent Damage and Healing. Damage and Healing reservoir duration increased from 8 to 10 seconds.
- Resonance: Reduced trigger damage from 5 to 3. Increased stack duration from 8 to 10.
- Soulward: Duration reduced from 8 to 7 seconds.
- Superheated: Now also increases Range by 3% per stack. Damage per stack reduced from 5% to 3%.
- Surge: Increased proc change from 20% to 25%.

RUNES
- Conduit: Generated Mana per stack increased from 1 to 2.
- Dark Pact: Reduced damage dealt from 1% per second to 2% every 3 seconds.

SHARDS
- Lifebinder: Cooldown increased from 4 to 5 seconds.
- Redemption: Will now immediately revive any destroyed Towers in range when placed.
- Wormhole: Reduced effectiveness against bosses.

ENEMIES
- Guardian: Reduced health by 5%. Reduced bonus damage of Infused Hammer from 50% to 25% per stack.
- Primal: Reduced health by 5%. Increased Mana Bolt cooldown from 12 to 14.
- Rumbler: Reduced movespeed from 80 to 70. Reduced health of Shardlings spawned from Crumble by 20%.
- Wisp: Soul Orb cooldown increased from 14 to 16 seconds.

ESSENCES
- Lifebloom (Reworked): Permanently increase the Max Health of ANY Tower by 2.
- Fire Rune: Reduced damage from 11 to 10

SHARDS
- Lifebinder: Reduced range from 30 to 25, increased cooldown from 3 to 4

ENEMIES
- Rak'Thor, the Earthshaper: Increased health slightly

UI
- Redesigned level over panel to explain the rating earned
- Changed the last wave tile in the waves panel to say 'Final Wave' instead of the wave number

LEVELS
- Fractured Isles (level 7): Increased difficulty
- Ildsgard Cliffs (level 8): Reduced difficulty

MISC
- Add resolution option to video settings

PERFORMANCE
- Improved performance on lower-end hardware by reducing RAM and VRAM usage

BUGS
- Fixed Shards being able to be placed close to the Nexus or enemy spawners
- Fixed debuff modifiers being displayed in incorrect order on enemies
- Fixed 'Aethyrn' achievement being incorrectly awarded

Balance:
- Increase forest boss's health slightly

Bug Fixes:
- Fixed the overworld sometimes not fading back in after the forest continent intro cinematic played
- Fixed the game difficulty being unable to be increased to legendary after a game was started on a lower difficulty
- Fixed edge panning not working for up and right directions
